description: Submit a new startup profile. A website is enough. Name, description, and sectors are optional. If you send only a website, the profile is listed on the free plan and the rest is filled in from that site. Gambling and adult content stay hidden. Upgrade is optional later. When you do send prose: third person, no listicle titles, no HTML/markdown. Returns 400 with field-level errors and suggestions on bad input. Costs 5 credits. One profile per company website domain. Optional logo_url is fetched and stored automatically. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

description.description: Full description in third person, 30–400 words, plain text only

logo_url.description: Optional URL to company logo image (PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG, ≤2MB). Server fetches + stores; if omitted, logo is auto-discovered from the website later.

name.description: Official company name (≤80 chars, no listicle words)

one_liner.description: One-sentence pitch in third person, 20–200 chars

website.description: Company website URL. This is the only required field.
